The agent must first locate an oak fence structure (find oak_fence), which serves as a landmark/navigation aid to reach a nearby building containing spruce stairs. The oak fence acts as a waypoint that guides the agent toward the structure where spruce stairs can be mined. This creates a natural dependency: the agent needs to visually identify and navigate to the oak fence area first, which then leads them to the spruce stairs location. Both tasks are observable, verifiable, and don't require deep crafting knowledge — just navigation and block-breaking skills.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the oak fence L-shaped pathway (centered around spawn-relative [3, 0, 4]) and face toward it, proving they visually identified the fence. The fence line runs from [3,0,2] to [3,0,6] then east to [6,0,6], so targeting [3,0,4] captures the middle of the main north-south segment. max_distance=5 ensures the player walked toward it (spawn is ~3.6 blocks away from nearest fence), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures intentional observation.

Uses inventory_has because mining spruce stairs with any tool (wooden axe provided) causes the block to drop as an item that enters the player's inventory. The player starts with no spruce_stairs, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks.

scene_description: A flat grass area with an L-shaped oak fence pathway that leads from near the player spawn to a small spruce plank cabin. The cabin has a wide 4-block entrance on the south-facing wall. Inside the cabin, spruce stairs line both sides of the floor (8 total). The player is given a wooden axe to mine the stairs. The oak fences serve as a navigational landmark that guides the player toward the cabin entrance.
task_text: Find the oak fence pathway nearby, then follow it to the spruce wood building. Go inside and mine a spruce stairs block.
design_notes: Fence L-path: runs from ~3,0,2 south to ~3,0,6 then east to ~6,0,6 connecting to the cabin at ~7-12,0-3,4-9. Cabin entrance: 4-wide opening at z=4 (blocks ~8-11 at y=1-2). Spruce stairs: 4 at y=0,z=5 (south-facing) and 4 at y=0,z=8 (north-facing) inside the cabin. Player spawns at origin with wooden axe. All within ~12 blocks of spawn. The air fill ensures no natural terrain obstructs the scene.
